notes: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result and market resolutions known. The v1 headline settings use the 2021 night only. The v2 sensitivity was also chosen after the 2025 result was known; archive searches found 2021 replayable, only one stamped page in 2017 and none in 2013, so its fixed multi-night rule also has only 2021 available. Neither version uses the 2025 count to select settings.

Two model versions are shown: v1 is the headline (solid line; configs/de2025_v1.toml). V2 is a sensitivity (thin dashed line; configs/de2025_v2.toml), chosen after the 2025 result was known with the fixed common calibration rule. Because 2017 and 2013 lack replayable archived nights, both calibrations use 2021 only.

Units are the 299 Wahlkreise (2025 boundaries). The count over time is replayed from the Bundeswahlleiterin's server-rendered result pages as the Internet Archive captured them: 15 distinct national pages, 40 Land pages and 177 single-Wahlkreis pages (each with its own 'Zwischenergebnis' stamp; a Wahlkreis stamp is its arrival time). First information: 19:38 UTC (20:38 CET, one Wahlkreis); national pages from 21:00 CET, 15 of them, 6 to 69 minutes apart (median 13.5); complete at 00:33 UTC (01:33 CET). Each page is used from its own stamp.

'Counted' is the share of the electorate of the Wahlkreise already reported. The map draws a Wahlkreis as counted only when its own page was archived (177 of 299); the others are drawn at the projection, although some of them were also counted (the national pages say how many Wahlkreise were in).

Share and raw (main race) are CDU/CSU's share of the CDU/CSU + AfD second votes; the other races have no share line. Map prior = the 2021 result recomputed on the 2025 constituencies (Bundeswahlleiterin).

P for every market comes from 20,000 joint draws of the final second-vote shares of the eight party groups: projection + correlated normal errors (sd from the 2021 night). 'Most seats' and 'second most seats' use the order of the second-vote shares (seats are proportional to them among the parties above 5%).

Markets not modelled: chancellor, coalition (they depend on bargaining, not on the count), 'Left in the Bundestag as a Fraktion' (needs the direct-mandate and seat count); 46 vote-share, threshold and seat-order markets are scored in the stats, 9 are drawn.

Official final (Bundeswahlleiterin, 14 March 2025), second votes: CDU/CSU 28.52%, AfD 20.8%, SPD 16.41%, Greens 11.61%, Die Linke 8.77%, BSW 4.98%, FDP 4.33%, Other 4.57%. BSW missed the 5% threshold by 0.02 points.
Polymarket was already at or above 0.9 on the eventual outcome when polls closed on 42 of 46 markets (exit polls at 18:00 CET are public information the count model does not use).

Evidence: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result and market resolutions known. The v1 headline settings use the 2021 night only. The v2 sensitivity was also chosen after the 2025 result was known; archive searches found 2021 replayable, only one stamped page in 2017 and none in 2013, so its fixed multi-night rule also has only 2021 available. Neither version uses the 2025 count to select settings.
